Metadata.description: Audiovisual consultants across Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador & southern Mexico. Fixers, logistics, gear, permits, casting & more for international productions.

Hero.headline: audiovisual consultants delivering exceptional solutions.
Hero.sub: We support productions in Guatemala, Honduras, El Salvador & southern Mexico.

About.body: We are a close, transparent team: horizontal communication with clients and collaborators is how we tailor solutions with an approachable, reliable, experienced crew. Our consulting is backed by a strong regional contact network.
About.manuelaBio: Scenography & film costume (Universidad del Cine, Buenos Aires). Field producer, assistant director & fixer on advertising, reality & documentary campaigns.
About.luisBio: Audiovisual creator (Casa Comal Film & TV School). Production on national & international projects; background in public administration & cultural management.
